Free Quote Home Renovation Atlanta

You're looking for a reliable contractor to renovate your home in Atlanta, and you want a clear idea of the costs involved. On this site, you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your home renovation project, and you'll receive a response within one business day.

How to Get Your Free Quote

To get started, you can fill out the quote form or contact us at info@buildheritage.org. We'll need some information about your project, including the type of renovation you're looking for and your location in the Atlanta area. Our team will review your request and provide you with a detailed quote that outlines the scope of work, materials, and costs. We offer 8 trades, including painting, drywall, flooring, and roofing, so you can trust that your project is in good hands.

What You Get and What It Costs

Our quotes are based on the specific needs of your project, and we provide ranges for common renovations, such as $3,000-$8,000 for a whole-home interior repaint and $9,000-$20,000 for a full roof replacement. We also recommend holding back 10-15% on top of your quote for any hidden issues that may arise during the project.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We serve the metro Atlanta area, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, and Sandy Springs. How long does it take to get a quote? You'll receive a response within one business day. Are you licensed and insured? Yes, we are licensed and insured in Georgia.

Get your free quote now
